document_chunks_line_range_check.name: document_chunks_line_range_check
document_chunks_line_range_check.value: ("document_chunks"."start_line" is null and "document_chunks"."end_line" is null) or ("document_chunks"."start_line" >= 1 and "document_chunks"."end_line" >= "document_chunks"."start_line")

document_chunks_source_code_provenance_c.name: document_chunks_source_code_provenance_check
document_chunks_source_code_provenance_c.value: "document_chunks"."source_type" <> 'source_code' or ("document_chunks"."path" is not null and "document_chunks"."commit_sha" is not null)

documents_source_code_provenance_check.name: documents_source_code_provenance_check
documents_source_code_provenance_check.value: "documents"."source_type" <> 'source_code' or ("documents"."path" is not null and "documents"."commit_sha" is not null)
